pages.text: $(thing)Farms$(): resource, plant and mob.$(br2)Adds an arrow on the left of the farm screen that opens the $(item)Crafting screen$(). Click a slot with an item to choose what the farm should $(item)craft$(); right-click clears it. Every cycle the farm crafts each target from its new drops and what is already in its output slots, and keeps the leftovers. A red slot means no crafting grid has a recipe for it.

Crafting uses $(item)grids$(): the crafting table 3x3 comes with the mod, and other mods or packs can add their own grids (a bigger crafter, say) with a data file; the card picks them up by itself.$(br2)Turn the card off with the $(item)craftingCardEnabled$() config.
